decisions.reason: A low-investment delivery program that is only mentioned on the website carries little public commitment, but it is close to the core offer and costs little to keep, so it will likely stay.
The seventy-two-hour express program is demanding to sustain and has low visibility, so dropping it would be easy, but it fits the firm's fast-response promise and is likely kept for now.
The firm invested in European approval and showcased the door on its home page at the BAU trade fair, a strong public commitment that management would defend.
A multi-model express line with its own page is a visible, invested commitment central to the firm's speed and service positioning.
The digital platform has a dedicated page and fits the firm's announced direction toward deeper service, so weak early results would be blamed on adoption time.
This fire and smoke protection door required certification investment and belongs to the firm's core safety portfolio, so keeping it is likely despite low web visibility.
